title: Maximum Normalized Mahler Measure of Littlewood Polynomials
exact_target: Let $P_n(x)=\sum_{k=0}^n a_kx^k$ range over Littlewood polynomials with $a_k\in\{-1,1\}$. Determine the extremal limit superior $b_m=\limsup_{n\to\infty}M_0(P_n)/\sqrt{n}$, where $M_0$ denotes Mahler measure.
